desc: Read the input values $N$ and the sequence $P$.
Initialize an array `final_positions` of size $N$ with -1 to store the final index for each number $i$.
Implement the Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree) class/functions.
Implement the binary lifting logic to find the $k$-th active (empty) index.
Iterate backwards from $i = N$ down to $1$:
For each $i$, find the $P_i$-th currently empty position using the Fenwick Tree.
Update the Fenwick Tree to mark this position as occupied.
Construct the final array by placing $i$ at `final_positions[i]`.
Test with provided samples mentally or via dry run.
Ensure constraints ($N=5 \times 10^5$) are handled efficiently (Python should be fast enough with $O(N \log N)$).
